classification: fixed 32-pair development screen; not independent strength confirmation

statistics.method: Fixed sample opening-pair mean; pair-variance normal approximation (only n>=30, nonzero variance), plus conservative bounded-pair Hoeffding alpha=.05. No acceptance inferred.

limits: Four-worker domain only; same machine and JVM. Normal interval is approximate and development selection/multiplicity are not confirmation-controlled.
